mission: Increase legitimate YouTube discovery, views, watch time and subscriber conversion by improving research, packaging, retention and content-market fit without artificial engagement.

inputs.publicYouTubeSearch: YouTube Data API when YOUTUBE_API_KEY is configured
inputs.channelAnalytics: Measured channel analytics or connected Metricool data

hardRules: Never buy, fabricate, automate, incentivize or exchange views, subscribers, likes, comments or watch time.
Never use sub-for-sub, view-for-view, comment spam or traffic-boosting services.
Never use traffic bots, watch-time bots or engagement farms.
Never copy another creator's protected script, thumbnail, footage, voice or edit.
Use public competitor examples only to learn topic demand and format patterns.
Every recommendation must preserve the channel's Christian identity and verified Scripture/factual standards.
Every experiment must change only one major variable unless explicitly reviewed.

researchTopics: forgive someone who hurt you Bible
Sea of Galilee Jesus Bible places
viewerNeedsCampaign.videoPackaging: Promise one specific viewer benefit; Jesus/Scripture grounded; no exaggeration
viewerNeedsCampaign.shorts: A finished original 59-second narrated Christian video with readable captions and intentional motion, not a still image montage.
viewerNeedsCampaign.longForm: A genuinely deeper companion video, not a repeated Short stretched with filler.
viewerNeedsCampaign.opening: Speak the audience's real problem in first seconds; answer it with a specific Scripture reference and practical response.
viewerNeedsCampaign.subscriberCTA: After delivering value, invite the viewer to the named next episode or series; no engagement tricks.
contentQualityGates: Christian scene suitability verified for the exact source hashes
Complete audio/visual/rights review of exact exported master
No release or schedule without durable final certification
growthLearning: views per video at comparable ages
chose-to-view versus swipe-away for Shorts when available
average watch duration and percentage viewed
CTR and traffic sources for long form when available

postingTimeTest.meaning: Metricool viewer-availability signal, not a proven causal advantage

historicalChannelDiscovery.finding: Top lifetime content mixes travel with Holy Land sites, especially Sea of Galilee and Jerusalem, plus general travel; NOT an all-Christian top-content list.
topicHypotheses: Sea of Galilee and the Gospel stories
Jerusalem Palm Sunday road and biblical geography
The Garden Tomb in Jerusalem: tradition and what the Gospels say
historicalChannelDiscovery.authenticity: Only describe exact places actually shown in footage; historic/original footage must be owned/licensed, verified and age/context disclosed. Do not claim the Garden Tomb is proven to be Jesus' tomb.
historicalChannelDiscovery.measurement: Test Holy Land Bible explainer content at comparable 24-hour and 7-day ages against prayer Shorts; include subscriber conversion and retention, not only views.
historicalChannelDiscovery.releaseGate: All final masters still need exact audiovisual review, rights and certification; no auto-posting.
